correctness.rationale: The explicitly admissible three-node model reduces to xdot=x(-d0-d1*y+q*x*(1-x)), ydot=x-y. Exact equilibrium geometry and the full Jacobian give imaginary eigenvalues at the stated parameterization. The canonical-coordinate derivatives yield l1=[4s-1-2(1-2s)omega^2]/[8s(1-2s)^2omega^2]. At rational examples (d0,d1,q,s,omega)=(1/4,5,8,1/4,1/2) and (3/4,15/4,9,1/3,1/2), l1=-2 and 9/4, and the trace derivatives are 1/8 and -7/9. Nondegenerate planar Hopf gives the cycles and their stability. Smooth perturbation and the implicit-function theorem give small positive pairwise persistence. CHECK.py reproduces these identities; no claim of transverse or global stability.
